query: Which formulas and simulations produce credible MDEs for IV/LATE analyses given anticipated first-stage F-statistics and compliance rates?

response.query: Which formulas and simulations produce credible MDEs for IV/LATE analyses given anticipated first-stage F-statistics and compliance rates?
response.answer: IV/LATE analyses use Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) and Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) for credible MDEs, given anticipated first-stage F-statistics and compliance rates. Simulation-based approaches like Monte Carlo can validate these methods.
